description: How many days an A/B test must run: from a known sample size per variant, or from baseline rate and MDE (computed as in calculate_sample_size), plus daily visitors and the share of traffic in the test. Returns exact days and the recommended whole weeks (to cover weekday effects).

baseline_rate.description: Control conversion rate, for computing the sample size.

daily_visitors.description: Eligible visitors per day across the whole site or page.

sample_size_per_variant.description: Known users per arm. If omitted, give baseline_rate and mde.

traffic_share.description: Fraction of those visitors entered into the test, default 1.

name: estimate_test_duration
title: A/B test duration estimator
